title: Green synthesis, characterization, morphological diversity, and colorectal cancer cytotoxicity of gold nanoparticles
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,36576-36592
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06340F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sultan Akhtar, Fatimah Zuhair, Muhammad Nawaz, Firdos Alam Khan
This study synthesizes gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) using gum Arabic (GA) and cinnamon (CNM) extracts. The AuNPs@GA and AuNPs@CNM show cytotoxicity against colorectal cancer cells (HCT-116), suggesting potential as a treatment option.
